protocol_metadata.about: Bitway Earn is a multi-currency staking protocol on BSC (and Ethereum) that allows users to deposit ERC-20 tokens into a Vault contract to earn dynamic rewards. Users receive non-fungible LP tokens as staking receipts and can withdraw via a managed queue (requestClaim/claim) with a waiting period or via an instant flash withdrawal subject to a penalty fee. A BOT_ROLE-controlled custodian mechanism transfers assets between the Vault and a separate WithdrawVault contract that handles claim payouts; a DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE controls emergency withdrawal, reward rates, blacklisting, and pause/unpause.
